value.rationale: The complete rank census quantifies associative-form degeneracy for every finite quiver, including non-Frobenius cases. It gives maximum possible rank in terms of directed incidence and distinguishes same-underlying-graph orientations. It is intrinsic, not a reparametrization of the known nondegenerate-form count.
